## ▶️ Start — `start`

Start here when you press Run, with some starting values (also defaults for Run Workflow).

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (has its own schedule/trigger)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `inputs` (Starting values) | list of rows {name, value} | `[]` |  |

Adds to the data: `(your names)` (One key per starting value.)

## ⏱ Timer — `timer`

Start the flow on a schedule, or delay it when placed after another block.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 660s
- Can start a workflow: yes (has its own schedule/trigger)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `seconds` (Seconds) | number | `60` | Under 30 seconds the extension keeps its background worker awake to fire on time (Chromium). 30 seconds or more uses browser alarms. After another block: waits up to 600 s inside the run; longer delays continue as a new run. |
| `repeat` (Repeat) | boolean | `true` | Only used when this block starts the flow. After another block it always fires once. |

Adds to the data: `tick` (How many times the timer has fired (when it starts the flow).); `firedAt` (ISO time the timer fired.)

## 📅 Schedule — `schedule`

Start the flow at set times: daily at 09:00, on weekdays, every hour, every N minutes.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (has its own schedule/trigger)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `every` (Every) | one of `day`, `hour`, `minutes` | `"day"` |  |
| `at` (At (HH:MM)) | text | `"09:00"` | For "day". Local time of this computer. |
| `days` (Days) | text | `"weekdays"` | For "day": every day, weekdays, weekends, or names: mon, wed, fri. |
| `minute` (Minute) | number | `0` | For "hour": minutes past the hour. |
| `minutes` (Minutes) | number | `15` | For "N minutes". Runs on the clock (:00, :15, :30…). |

Adds to the data: `firedAt` (When it fired.); `scheduledFor` (The time it was planned for.)

## 🌍 Page Visited — `page-visited`

Start when you open a matching page (in any tab). That tab becomes "main".

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (has its own schedule/trigger)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` (Page URL pattern) | text | `""` | required. Plain text = the URL contains it; * any part between slashes; ** anything; /…/ regex. |
| `when` (When) | one of `load`, `any` | `"load"` |  |

Adds to the data: `url` (The page address.); `title` (The page title.); `tabId` (The tab.)

## 🖱 Context Menu — `context-menu`

Add an item to the right-click menu that starts the flow on that page.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (has its own schedule/trigger)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` (Menu item) | text | `"Run my workflow"` | required |
| `contexts` (Show it when right-clicking) | one of `all`, `page`, `selection`, `link`, `image` | `"all"` |  |

Adds to the data: `url` (The page address.); `selection` (Selected text, if any.); `link` (The link right-clicked, if any.); `src` (The image right-clicked, if any.)

## 👁 Watch Element — `watch-element`

Fire when the text of a part of a web page changes.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (has its own schedule/trigger)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locator` (Element) | locator | `""` | required |
| `url` (Page URL) | url | `""` | required, supports `{{…}}` |
| `intervalSeconds` (Check every (seconds)) | number | `60` | Only used when this block starts the flow. After a Timer, the Timer decides. Under 30 seconds keeps the background worker awake. |
| `reload` (Reload page before checking) | boolean | `true` | Needed to see server-side changes. Turn off for pages that update themselves. |
| `emitOnFirstRead` (Fire on the first read too) | boolean | `false` | Off = the first read just records the starting value. |

Adds to the data: `value` (The new text of the element.); `previous` (The text before the change (null on the first read).); `url` (The page that was watched.); `locator` (The element locator (also as `selector`, its name before v0.3).); `changedAt` (ISO time the change was noticed.)

## 🔗 Open Tab — `open-url`

Open a web page, and remember the tab for the next blocks.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 45s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` (URL) | url | `""` | required, supports `{{…}}`. Use {{name}} to insert a value from the previous block. |
| `where` (Open in) | one of `new`, `workflow`, `window`, `current` | `"new"` |  |
| `tab` (Tab name) | text | `"main"` | Later blocks find the tab by this name. Use another name (e.g. "admin") for a second tab. |
| `active` (Switch to it) | boolean | `true` | Off = open quietly in the background. |
| `waitUntil` (Continue when) | one of `load`, `networkidle`, `none` | `"load"` |  |

Adds to the data: `url` (The URL that was opened.); `tabId` (Id of the tab it was opened in.)

## 🧭 Navigate — `navigate`

Go to a URL, back, forward, or reload, in a tab of this run.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 45s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |
| `action` (Action) | one of `goto`, `back`, `forward`, `reload` | `"goto"` |  |
| `url` (URL) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}` |
| `waitUntil` (Continue when) | one of `load`, `networkidle`, `none` | `"load"` |  |

Adds to the data: `url` (The URL after navigating.)

## 🪟 Wait for Popup — `wait-for-popup`

Catch a new tab or window the page opened, and name it for the next blocks.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tab` (Opened by tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |
| `name` (Call the new tab) | text | `"popup"` | required |
| `waitUntil` (Continue when) | one of `load`, `networkidle`, `none` | `"load"` |  |

Adds to the data: `popupUrl` (The address of the new tab.); `popupTabId` (Its tab id.)

## 📥 Wait for Download — `wait-for-download`

Wait until the page downloads a file (an export, a report) and get its name, size and type. Can read CSV / JSON / text files.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 60s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` (URL or file name (optional)) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. Empty = the first download. Plain text: the address or file name contains it; * and /regex/ as in Wait For. |
| `read` (Read the file) | one of `none`, `text`, `csv`, `json` | `"none"` | Extensions cannot open files on disk, so the file is fetched again from its address (with the site's cookies). Fine for exports; a link that makes a new file each time gives that new file. |
| `dataset` (Save rows to dataset (optional)) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. CSV rows, or a JSON list, replace this dataset. |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The tab that starts the download. Needed only to read files the page made itself (blob: addresses). |

Adds to the data: `download` ({filename, url, path, size, mime, downloadId} of the finished download.); `content` (With "as text": the file content.); `rows` (With "as CSV": one object per row, by header.); `data` (With "as JSON": the parsed value.); `datasetSize` (With a dataset: its rows afterwards.)

## 🍪 Cookies & Storage — `cookies-storage`

Read, set, delete or clear a site's cookies, or the page's localStorage / sessionStorage.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` (Do) | one of `get`, `set`, `delete`, `clear` | `"get"` |  |
| `area` (In) | one of `cookies`, `local`, `session` | `"cookies"` |  |
| `name` (Name / key) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. Needed to set or delete. For get: empty = all of them. |
| `value` (Value) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. For set. |
| `url` (Site (cookies, optional)) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. Whose cookies. Empty = the page open in the tab. |
| `domain` (Domain (set, optional)) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. With a leading dot the cookie is also sent to subdomains. |
| `path` (Path (set, optional)) | text | `""` |  |
| `maxAgeSeconds` (Expires in seconds (set)) | number | `0` | 0 = a session cookie, gone when the browser closes. |
| `httpOnly` (HttpOnly (set)) | boolean | `false` |  |
| `secure` (Secure (set)) | boolean | `false` |  |
| `sameSite` (SameSite (set)) | one of ``, `Lax`, `Strict`, `None` | `""` |  |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `value` (get with a name: the value (null when missing). get without: an object of name → value. set: the value.); `cookies` (Cookies, get/set: the full cookies [{name, value, domain, path, expires, httpOnly, secure, sameSite}].); `deleted` (delete / clear: how many were removed.)

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

## 👆 Click — `click`

Click (or double-click, right-click, hover) an element, with any button, modifier keys and position. Waits until it can be clicked.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)
- Step setting `realInput` ("Use real mouse and keyboard") applies to this block

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locator` (Element) | locator | `""` | required, supports `{{…}}`. CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick. |
| `action` (Action) | one of `click`, `double`, `right`, `hover` | `"click"` |  |
| `button` (Mouse button) | one of `left`, `middle`, `right` | `"left"` | For "click". Right-click always uses the right button. |
| `modifiers` (Keys held) | text | `""` | Modifier keys held during the click: Alt, Control, Meta, Shift (joined with + or commas). Empty = none. |
| `position` (Position) | text | `""` | Where to click: x,y in pixels from the element’s top-left corner. Empty = its center. |
| `clickCount` (Click count) | number | `1` | Presses in a row (3 = triple click, selects a paragraph). Double-click means at least 2. |
| `force` (Skip the checks) | boolean | `false` | Click even if the element looks hidden, disabled or covered. Only for stubborn pages. |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `(same data)` (The input, passed on.)

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locator` (Field) | locator | `""` | required, supports `{{…}}`. CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick. |
| `value` (Value) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}` |
| `mode` (How) | one of `fill`, `type` | `"fill"` |  |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

## 📋 Fill Form — `fill-form`

Fill several fields at once: text, selects, checkboxes. Optionally click submit.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)
- Step setting `realInput` ("Use real mouse and keyboard") applies to this block

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fields` (Fields) | list of rows {locator, value} | `[]` | required. Empty values are skipped. Selects take the option text or value; checkboxes take true or false. |
| `submit` (Then click (optional)) | locator | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick. |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `(same data)` (The input, passed on.)

## ⏎ Press Key — `press-key`

Press a key or shortcut (Enter, Tab, Escape, Control+A…), or insert text at the caret.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)
- Step setting `realInput` ("Use real mouse and keyboard") applies to this block

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` (Do) | one of `key`, `text` | `"key"` |  |
| `key` (Key) | text | `"Enter"` | Key names as on the keyboard: Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, ArrowDown, a, Control+A, Shift+Tab, Control+Shift+K. ControlOrMeta+A is ⌘A on a Mac, Ctrl+A elsewhere. |
| `text` (Text) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. For "insert text": typed at the caret in one go, like pasting. |
| `locator` (On element (optional)) | locator | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. Focus this element first. Empty = whatever has focus. |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `(same data)` (The input, passed on.)

## ✋ Drag — `drag`

Drag an element onto another one: sortable lists, kanban cards, sliders, drop targets.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)
- Step setting `realInput` ("Use real mouse and keyboard") applies to this block

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` (Drag this) | locator | `""` | required, supports `{{…}}`. The element to pick up (a card, a list item, a slider handle). |
| `to` (Drop on) | locator | `""` | required, supports `{{…}}`. The element to drop it on (another item, a column, a spot on the slider track). |
| `fromPosition` (Grab at) | text | `""` | x,y in pixels from the top-left corner of "Drag this". Empty = its center. |
| `toPosition` (Drop at) | text | `""` | x,y in pixels from the top-left corner of "Drop on". Empty = its center. |
| `modifiers` (Keys held) | text | `""` | Modifier keys held during the drag: Alt, Control, Meta, Shift. |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `(same data)` (The input, passed on.); `dragMode` ("html5" (drag events) or "pointer" (pointer/mouse moves): how the page took the drag.)

## 🎛️ Element Action — `element-action`

Focus, blur, clear, scroll into view, or dispatch an event (click, input, a custom event) on an element.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locator` (Element) | locator | `""` | required, supports `{{…}}`. CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick. |
| `action` (Action) | one of `focus`, `blur`, `clear`, `scroll-into-view`, `dispatch-event` | `"focus"` |  |
| `eventType` (Event type) | text | `""` | For "dispatch an event". Bubbles, cancelable and composed. |
| `detail` (Detail (JSON)) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. For "dispatch an event". Built-in types (click, keydown, input, focus, drag…): the event’s properties. Other types are a CustomEvent and this is its event.detail. |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `(same data)` (The input, passed on.); `defaultPrevented` (For "dispatch an event": true when the page cancelled the event.)

## 📎 Upload File — `upload-file`

Choose a file for a file input or drop it on a drop zone, without the file dialog: text you write, a file from a URL, or base64 data.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locator` (File input or drop zone) | locator | `"input[type=file]"` | required, supports `{{…}}`. The <input type="file"> (hidden ones work too) or its label; with "drop zone", the area files are dropped on. |
| `target` (Put it) | one of `input`, `dropzone` | `"input"` |  |
| `source` (File) | one of `text`, `url`, `data` | `"text"` |  |
| `content` (Content) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. For "text". |
| `url` (URL) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. For "download". |
| `data` (Data) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. For "base64 data": base64 or a data: URL, usually {{body64}} from HTTP Request with "Response as: base64". |
| `filename` (File name) | text | `"upload.txt"` | supports `{{…}}`. Empty with a URL = the name in the URL. |
| `mime` (Type) | text | `"text/plain"` | supports `{{…}}`. For "text" and "base64 data" ({{mime}} after HTTP Request; a data: URL brings its own). With a URL the server says. |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `uploaded` (The file name.)

## 🖱️ Scroll — `scroll`

Scroll to the bottom, top or an element; or keep scrolling until no more content loads.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 120s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `to` (Scroll) | one of `end`, `bottom`, `top`, `element` | `"end"` |  |
| `locator` (Element) | locator | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. Only for "to an element". |
| `maxScrolls` (At most (scrolls)) | number | `20` |  |
| `pauseMs` (Wait between scrolls (ms)) | number | `1000` |  |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `scrolls` (How many times it scrolled.)

## ⏳ Wait For — `wait-for`

Wait until an element appears or goes, some text shows, the URL changes, or the page settles.

- Outputs (ports): `out` (plus `error` when step.onError is "port")
- Default timeout: 30s
- Can start a workflow: yes (runs once with empty data)

| Setting (`config` key) | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` (Wait until) | one of `visible`, `hidden`, `attached`, `detached`, `enabled`, `text`, `no-text`, `url`, `load`, `networkidle`, `response`, `request` | `"visible"` |  |
| `locator` (Element) | locator | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. For the element modes. For text: only look inside this element (optional). |
| `text` (Text) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}` |
| `url` (URL pattern) | text | `""` | supports `{{…}}`. Plain text: the URL contains it. * matches any part between slashes, ** anything. /…/ is a regular expression. Also the request address for the network modes. |
| `status` (Status (optional)) | text | `""` | For "a network request finishes". |
| `method` (Method (optional)) | text | `""` | For the network modes. Empty = any. |
| `captureBody` (Capture the response body) | boolean | `false` | For "a network request finishes". Chrome, Edge, Brave only (debugger permission). Only responses that start after this block starts can be read, so it suits slow or later requests. |
| `tab` (Tab) | text | `"main"` | The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main". |

Adds to the data: `url` (The tab's URL when the wait ended.); `response` (For "a network request finishes": {url, status, method}, plus body (or bodyBase64) with "Capture the response body".); `request` (For "the page sends a request": {url, method, type, postData}.)

Each case is an output named after it (letters, digits, "_" and "-"; not "default", "error", "out" or "done"). No match goes to "default". For a pattern, write /text/i. |

Adds to the data: `(same data)` (The input, unchanged, out of the matching case or "default".)
